forum.title: Lacking pins for OV2640 DCMI on STM32F469I-DISCO
forum.best_answer_content: It can be done if you have the experience and equipment to solder wires to a trace or to pads. But a different board is going to be much easier.
forum.content_text:
![Screenshot 2026-03-06 225837.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9a138d13-76a9-6ab6-5d40-1bda69cdcbee.png "Screenshot 2026-03-06 225837.png")

![carri453_0-1772861215697.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/676431f9-ac9c-53ce-6557-c3b7bde755e8.png "carri453_0-1772861215697.png")

This is the pinout for the STM32F469I-DISCO and OV2640, I have been able to find pins for most of them but am having trouble:

* DCMI Pinout: (Pin function : Actual pin name)

+ DCMI\_D0 : PC6

+ DCMI\_D1: PC7

+ DCMI\_D2: PG10

+ DCMI\_D3: PG11

+ DCMI\_D4: Missing

+ DCMI\_D5: PD3

+ DCMI\_D6: Conflict with PB8

+ DCMI\_D7: Conflict with PB9

+ DCMI\_VSYNC: PG9

+ DCMI\_HSYNC: PA4

+ DCMI\_PIXCLK: PA6

+ RCC\_MCO\_1: PA8 (Note: we can use this pin to generate the XCLK signal needed by the OV2640

+ SIOC: PB8

+ SIOD: PB9

I would appreciate it if anyone has a solution for this, thanks
forum.author: carri453

scraped_replies.html:
The datasheet of the chip lists all pins available for DCMI functions.

> DCMI_D4: Missing

PE4 or PH14

Those pins are already in use on the board and aren't exposed on any headers, so you'll need to do that manually.

https://www.st.com/resource/en/schematic_pack/mb1189-c01_schematic.pdf

 

Generally Nucleo board are better for connecting dense external peripherals. On discovery boards most pins are already in use.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html: So if there are no exposed pins then am I better off buying another board or is there another way to still use it?
scraped_replies.author: carri453

scraped_replies.html: It can be done if you have the experience and equipment to solder wires to a trace or to pads. But a different board is going to be much easier.
scraped_replies.author: TDK
